summary: Gated refresh_objectives_on_resume on PHASE2_PER_EPOCH_WINDOW_ROTATION flag. When rotation is ON (default, post task-1), behavior is identical to pre-task-10 (refresh = not first_epoch). When rotation is OFF (legacy fixed-window), refresh is skipped even on resumed epochs — the cache is valid and the wipe was wasteful, dropping cache_hit_rate to 0-7%. Updated comment block with audit finding #8 linkage. Added 4 unit tests covering all combinations of rotation ON/OFF × first_epoch/resumed_epoch.
acceptance_criteria_met: AC1: PHASE2_PER_EPOCH_WINDOW_ROTATION=True → refresh = not first_epoch (bit-identical to pre-task-10)
AC2: PHASE2_PER_EPOCH_WINDOW_ROTATION=False → refresh = False even on resumed epochs (cache NOT cleared)
AC3: Default config behavior is bit-identical to pre-task-10 (PHASE2_PER_EPOCH_WINDOW_ROTATION=True is the default)
